pages.text:
Week 2 — Asymptotic Analysis

- count steps, not seconds
- Big-O: upper bound, ignore constants and lower-order terms
- 3n^2 + 5n + 2 is O(n^2)

Common growth rates, slowest growing first:
- O(1)
- O(log n)
- O(n)
- O(n log n)
- O(n^2)
- O(2^n)

O(2^n) is infeasible beyond small n

Example: nested loops over n items = n * n = O(n^2)

One loop that halves n each pass = O(log n)
